profile.name: Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5
profile.subtitle: BCM2712 / RP1 · 4 × Cortex-A76 · Dual 100-pin Hirose DF40
profile.processor: Broadcom BCM2712 (4 × Arm Cortex-A76 @ 2.4 GHz) + RP1 I/O

facts.value: Optional eMMC (16/32/64 GB) or Lite (external SD)

value.tr: 5 V güç girişi (4.75–5.25 V). GPIO_VREF ile 3.3 V veya 1.8 V I/O seçilebilir.
value.en: 5 V main power input (4.75-5.25 V). Select 3.3 V or 1.8 V I/O via GPIO_VREF.

text.tr: BCM2712 SoC ve RP1 I/O denetleyicisi ile PCIe Gen 2/3 ×1, 2× USB 3.0, çift 4Kp60 HDMI, fan tacho/PWM ve RTC batarya desteği sunar.
text.en: Features BCM2712 SoC and RP1 I/O controller with PCIe Gen 2/3 x1, 2× USB 3.0, dual 4Kp60 HDMI, fan tacho/PWM, and RTC battery support.
